notes:
Lead source: inbound trial signup from docs-search article. Small legal-tech startup building contract clause search and extraction. Primary contact: Priya Sharma (Head of Product). Wants a self-serve sandbox to validate embeddings + reranking pipeline end-to-end. Current stack: frontend -> Pinecone (annoy) -> simple lexical filters -> OpenAI embeddings + bespoke BERT-based reranker hosted on EC2. Pain points: cost (OpenAI heavy), inconsistent reranker latency, difficulty tuning recall/precision tradeoff. Customer quote: "Need answers that point to exact clause and show source snippet — high precision matters."

Technical requirements / asks (paraphrased):
- Embedding throughput: batch ingest ~10k docs first phase, ongoing incremental ingest ~200/day
- Online query throughput: target 30-50 QPS peak, p50 latency target 120ms end-to-end, p95 under 400ms for RAG answers
- Reranking: prefer lightweight reranker to run after ANN recall; ask about small transformer reranker hosted on Redwood or recommended infra pattern
- Vector DB integration: currently using Pinecone; wants to know pros/cons of continuing managed vector DB vs Redwood-managed vector store (latency, cold-start, consistency with hosted API)
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; looking for predictable per-embedding pricing and suggestions to reduce token spend (caching, chunk sizing, quantized models)

Security/compliance notes:
- Requires SOC2 evidence before POC (team asked for attestation copy)
- Wants SSO (SAML) for admin users and audit logs for API keys
- Data residency: US-only preferred but not mandatory for now

Internal AE notes:
- Priya responded positively to demo video. She will try sandbox this week. Prioritize sending embedding quickstart and a small Python notebook that shows Pinecone + Redwood hosted API flow. SE to prepare a short benchmark plan (ingest 200 docs, 10 queries) to demonstrate reranking latencies and recall improvements.

Potential upsell path: start hosted_api self-serve -> move to committed Dedicated once throughput >100 QPS or if SLAs needed. Estimated ARR small but expansion potential with enterprise legal customers.
use_case_summary: Build contract clause search + answer extraction using embeddings for recall and a reranker for precision. Validate hosted_api for embeddings + generation; integrate with existing Pinecone instance or migrate vector store; need predictable costs and SOC2 evidence.
technical_constraints: Public cloud preferred (AWS). No air-gapped. Wants simple onboarding via SDK/REST. Needs KMS support for keys and audit logs visible in Console.
